name: Jeremy Parker
title: Contact Psychologist
description: I am a registered psychologist with over 30 years of experience, experienced in trauma and trauma-informed treatment. My approach is compassionate, evidence-based, and tailored to each individual. I am trained in EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing), EFT (Emotion-Focused Therapy), and other modalities to support recovery from complex trauma, grief, and critical incidents.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Partners/families of sex offenders, Sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sex offenders, EMDR

name: Dr Christopher Trewavas
title: Psychologist
description: I am a clinical psychologist who focuses on evidence-based mental health assessment, diagnosis and treatment. You will receive confidential, respectful and effective support to overcome personal problems and help realise your unique potential.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Schema Therapy

name: Dr Andrew Sinclair
title: Psychologist
description: The focus of my psychology practice has been working with people who have physical disability and injuries following trauma such as a spinal cord injury as well as people with complex and painful medical conditions. Taking a bio-psycho-social approach, I have significant experience in working with chronic pain, trauma, anger, anxiety, sleep and adjustment issues.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy

name: Tania Krecek
title: Psychologist
description: Tania offers a warm, genuine, and collaborative approach to therapy. She takes a person-centred approach, drawing on evidence-based therapies to support positive change.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

name: Dina Jones
title: Psychologist
description: Dina has a passionate interest in providing psychological services to adults across the lifespan, from emerging adulthood to older adults. She believes that psychology can bring about positive change and improve quality of life.

name: Jessica Ekserdjian
title: Psychologist
description: Jess (pronouns: she/her) is aware of the courage it takes to seek psychological support and feels privileged to work with clients to foster a safe, warm and collaborative therapeutic relationship. Jess has a broad spectrum of experience as a psychologist, working with clients across the lifespan in public and private settings, and in inpatient, outpatient, and outreach settings.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)

name: Yuedda Sio
title: Psychologist
description: Yuedda is the Director of Inner Eastern Psychology, at which she is joined by a group of experienced psychologists providing evidence-based and inclusive practice. Yuedda’s values of acceptance, authenticity, and hope are reflected in her warm, approachable and dialectical therapeutic style. Yuedda is also experienced in providing treatment for issues following trauma or abuse. Additionally, Yuedda is passionate about working with LGBTIQA-identifying individuals and communities.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Laura Humphreys
title: Psychologist
description: I am the Principal Psychologist and Director of Yarra City Psychology. At YCP our psychologists and neuropsychologists understand that a strong therapeutic relationship is the basis of the best therapies and assessments. At YCP, I strive to lead a neurodiversity and disability affirming team who are LGBTQIA+ welcoming.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Adult survivors of sexual abuse, EMDR, Schema Therapy
